Hi Samir + Priya,

Thanks again for taking the discovery call today — appreciated the context on real-time claims routing and cost volatility during peak hours. Quick recap and a short ask so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce tail latency spikes for routing engine (95/99p) while cutting per-token inference costs for routing models by ~30%.
- Current infra: mixed on-prem + cloud GPUs, limited ability to autoscale quickly, KV cache not utilized at the app layer.
- Constraints: SOC2 + data residency for PII, preferred region: us-west.

How Redwood maps to that problem
- Unified runtime that can run in your VPC (private) or on our hosted plane with VPC peering; predictable tail SLOs and KV caching to reduce repeated tokens.
- We have a small pilot playbook (30 days) we typically run for infra + routing workloads; low-friction onboarding with a small reserved pool and a short eval prompt set.

Proposed next step
- Would you be open to a short pilot focused on a single service/route (1–2 GPU equivalent) for 30 days? We can cover the initial infra credits and work with your security team on SOC2 artifacts.
- If a pilot is too much right now, a 15-minute technical sync next week to map the minimal integration surface would be great.

Attached: Orion_Discovery_Deck_20270503.pdf (high-level pilot plan + scope).

Curious if this aligns with your priorities — any feedback on fit or timing?

Thanks,
Monica
